Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. I am glad you told me about your interest in sorting household waste. You asked for advice, so I have a few suggestions that you might find helpful. You do not need to do everything at once.

Thanks for your email. I am glad you told me about your interest in [chủ đề]. You asked for advice, so I have a few suggestions that you might find helpful. You do not need to do everything at once.

paragraphs.text: If I were you, I would start by joining a neighbourhood recycling workshop. There, you could practise sorting common household items.
